summary: The change raises the standard (non-privileged) session idle timeout from 30 to 45 minutes in payments. No product obligation is violated because the privileged idle timeout (SES-1) and dual-control threshold (PAY-1) are unchanged. However, CHG-6 is refuted: the change modifies a protected path (controls/payments/policy-params.json), which requires a control_owner approval from someone holding that role and outside the author's team. The recorded control_owner approval is from Mara Costa, who holds only 'engineer' and 'change_approver' roles (not 'control_owner') and is on the same payments-eng team as the author. No valid control_owner approval is on record, so the change cannot be accepted.
